trends.name: Iran Strait of Hormuz Control & Oil Tolls
trends.summary: Iran is asserting control over the Strait of Hormuz, capping vessel transits at ~15/day under ceasefire terms and demanding cryptocurrency tolls on tankers. This is creating a critical oil supply bottleneck with only 55% probability of normalization before July 1, directly impacting global energy prices and inflation outlook.

trends.name: AI Computing Race: OpenAI vs Anthropic
trends.summary: OpenAI is claiming a key computing resource advantage over rival Anthropic in a critical moment as Anthropic mulls going public. This reflects intensifying competition for AI infrastructure dominance and suggests significant capex competition will continue pressuring margins across the AI stack.

trends.name: Trump Administration China Telecom Restrictions
trends.summary: Trump administration is planning fresh clampdowns on Chinese telecom carriers' US operations, signaling escalating tech/telecom decoupling. This has broad implications for semiconductors, cloud infrastructure, and US-China tech competition.

trends.name: Software Sector Breakdown & Valuation Reset
trends.summary: Software stocks experiencing 'full-fledged breakdown' with Adobe down 2/3 from late-2021 highs, alongside ServiceNow, Salesforce, and HubSpot all hitting fresh lows. This suggests a broader AI-driven valuation reset in SaaS as buyers shift priorities and software ROI becomes questioned.

trends.name: S&P 500 Rally: +$4.5T in 8 Trading Days
trends.summary: Market posts longest winning streak since October 2025 with +8% gain since March 30th low, adding $4.5 trillion in market cap. However, real-time sentiment notes 'asset owners are the only winners,' suggesting retail investors and labor are not participating in this recovery.

trends.name: Iran-Israel Ceasefire Fragility & War Risk
trends.summary: While US and UK confirm ceasefire with Strait of Hormuz opening agreement, Iran's parliament speaker warns 'time is running out' and ceasefire violations are alleged. Market consensus views this as unstable; any escalation could trigger sharp oil spike and 'war's over' rally reversal.

trends.name: AI Monetization & Profitability Questions
trends.summary: Meta's AI model launch raises fundamental questions about AI monetization; Amazon doubles down on $200B AI spend with commitment to 'not be conservative.' CoreWeave bounces on Meta deal news but broader concern persists: can these massive AI capex investments actually generate returns?

trends.name: Energy Dominance Shift & Petrodollar Reinvention
trends.summary: Iran's demands for crypto tolls and broader geopolitical shifts are testing US energy dominance and petrodollar hegemony. US energy policy is becoming a critical geopolitical lever, with implications for commodity pricing, currency dynamics, and emerging market stability.

trends.name: Inflation Concerns & Real Income Decline
trends.summary: Personal incomes saw rare decline with real incomes at lowest since December 2022, while core inflation remains elevated despite some supercore easing. Grocery and food inflation specifically highlighted as next casualty of geopolitical tensions, pressuring consumer spending and earnings.

trends.name: Nvidia's AI Momentum & Longest Win Streak
trends.summary: Nvidia is quietly gaining steam with longest winning streak since 2023, riding AI infrastructure demand. This contrasts sharply with broader software sector weakness, positioning semiconductor/infrastructure plays as the AI winner relative to software applications.

trends.name: Autonomous Vehicle & Defense Capex Surge
trends.summary: US military draft registration planned by December signals major defense spending acceleration; combined with autonomous vehicle and AI capex surge themes. This creates sustained demand for semiconductors, specialized hardware, and defense contractors independent of corporate AI ROI questions.

trends.name: Cruise & Travel Sector Execution Risk
trends.summary: Norwegian Cruise Line execution mistakes and broader travel sector headwinds are weighing on valuations. Brown-Forman merger drama heats up while Southwest gets upgraded despite oil shock, suggesting selective opportunities but broad sector facing structural challenges from operational complexity.
